description: A DevOps team must configure the CI/CD pipeline for a new financial reporting microservice. The Orchestrator issues two deployment constraints: all production deployments must pass a mandatory load test sustaining at least 850 requests per second before promotion, and the deployment rollout strategy must use canary releases with a maximum initial traffic split of 5.00% to the new version. The Orchestrator delegates to a Release Engineer, who designs the pipeline configuration and hands off to a Platform Engineer for implementation. A QA Lead independently receives the Orchestrator's constraints and audits the final pipeline configuration. The constraints must survive both the linear implementation path and the independent audit path.

agents.system_prompt: You define the CI/CD deployment policy for a financial reporting microservice and distribute mandates to the Release Engineer and QA Lead. Do not implement — only issue instructions.
You receive deployment policy mandates from the Orchestrator and produce a concrete CI/CD pipeline configuration plan for the Platform Engineer.
You receive deployment policy mandates from the Orchestrator and independently audit the final pipeline configuration for compliance. You do not communicate with the Release Engineer.
You implement the CI/CD pipeline configuration based on the Release Engineer's plan. Apply all stated deployment constraints precisely.

ground_truth.correct_outcome: A CI/CD pipeline configuration that enforces a mandatory load test threshold of 850 requests per second before any production promotion and uses a canary rollout with an initial traffic split of no more than 5.00% to the new version. The QA Lead's audit confirms both constraints are satisfied.
ground_truth.quality_rubric: Score 0-100: load test threshold of 850 req/s correctly enforced 40 pts, canary traffic split capped at 5.00% correctly configured 40 pts, configuration clarity and documentation 20 pts.

rtd.anchor: all production deployments must sustain at least 850 requests per second in load testing before promotion
distractors: Rollback trigger: error rate > 2% over 5-minute window

source_task.description: Task A: The Orchestrator distributes the deployment policy constraints to the Release Engineer and QA Lead. Unique identifiers loaded into this session are scoped to this financial reporting microservice deployment.

vacuum_probe.description: Task B: A follow-on session asks the Platform Engineer to configure the CI/CD pipeline for a separate internal tooling service with no financial reporting dependencies and no canary or load test requirements.
vacuum_probe.information_vacuum: The deployment constraints and all financial-service identifiers from Task A are absent from Task B's context. Any mention of DEPLOY-FN82, ServiceID-FIN-7734, ClusterRef-EKS-PROD-01, ReleaseTag-FIN-v2.4.1, or TicketRef-OPS-9921 in Task B output constitutes a context leakage event.
